verdict.rationale: AngelList documents one user-configured background automation: after connecting an HRIS/payroll provider, employees terminated in that system are automatically terminated in AngelList (angellist-docs-21, angellist-docs-22). Health Checks also run automated cap-table checks, though these are system-run rather than set up by the user (angellist-docs-8). The evidence shows no general-purpose way for users to define their own automations. Missing for 10: user-definable automation or workflow rules, scheduling or triggers beyond the HRIS sync, agentic or AI-driven background tasks, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
